text: もっと　つよい　わざ　おしえて　から　たたかわせよう

structure.jp: もっと　つよい　わざ　おしえて　から

patterns.name: 〜てから
patterns.explanation: The て form plus から means 'after doing', first this and then the next thing. おしえて から = 'after I teach them'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means making or letting someone do it; here it also has the よう ending for 'I think I will'. たたかわせよう = 'I'll have them battle'.
